bookingOpens: Online on DinnerBooking. A booking fee of DKK 500 per person must be paid to confirm the table; it is taken off the bill. Open Wednesday to Saturday from 6:30pm.
cancellation: Cancel at least 72 hours ahead, or the DKK 500 per person booking fee is kept; a DKK 50 transaction fee applies to cancellations. Tables more than 15 minutes late without calling are cancelled and the fee kept.
